introduce:
Lie on the floor with your toes and forearms on the ground. Keep your body straight and hold this position as long as you can. 

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.

This exercise strengthens the abdomen, back and shoulders.
name: PLANK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
Breathe naturally.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your lower back.
Too hard? Lower your knees on the mat with your ankles crossed in the air.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
It's not right if your shoulders or lower back are sore.
This exercise works your core.
This exercise is good for your spine.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart. Place your arms at your sides, palms pressing gently into the mat.

Inhale deeply, press through your feet to lift your hips off the floor. Let your chest open and gently draw it toward your chin, creating a natural arch in your back. Keep your shoulders grounded and your gaze upward. 

Hold the pose for a few breaths. With each inhale, lengthen through your spine; with each exhale, relax into the stretch.
name: BRIDGE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominal muscles.
Inhale to lengthen through your spine. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
Lift your one leg up if it's too easy for you.
This is a great exercise to target your legs, core and gluteus.

introduce:
Start in the push-up position, but keep your arms straight. 

Keep your body straight and hold this position as long as you can. 

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.

This exercise strengthens your abdomen and back muscles.
name: STRAIGHT-ARM PLANK

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Put your hands directly underneath your shoulders.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Do not sink your lower back or raise your hips in the air.
Breathe deeply.
Too easy for you? Add weight on your lower back.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This exercise really works on your core and lower back.

introduce: Lie on your stomach with your arms extended straight overhead. Then raise both your arms and legs up off the floor. \n\nHold this position for two seconds. Return to the start position and repeat.
name: SUPERMAN

tips.text: You should do it on a mat.
Squeeze your glutes.
Exhale on the way up, and inhale on the way down.
If you feel it's too hard, alternately raise your opposite legs and arms.
To make it easier, you can just raise your legs or arms.
This exercise will engage your abs.
This exercise will strengthen your butt and lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and feet close together. Place your hands beneath your shoulders, and bend your elbows close to your body.

Inhale deeply, press your palms into the floor, lifting your chest and shoulders off the ground. Keep your hips pressed firmly into the floor. 

Hold for a few breaths, raise and lower with your breath. On inhale, lift into spinal extension. On exhale, soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lift the chest. Exhale to soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce: Lie on the floor with your feet together. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together. Let your knees fall comfortably out to the sides, moving them toward the floor. \n\nPlace your hands by your sides or on your belly, and begin to breathe slowly and deeply through your nose. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to allow your knees to sink closer to the floor.
name: LYING BUTTERFLY STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch in your groin.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your knees down.
Try to let your knees get closer and closer to the floor.

introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height. 

Move your arms clockwise in circles fast.

Try to do it as fast as you can.

It's a great exercise for the deltoid muscle.
name: ARM CIRCLES CLOCKWISE

tips.text: Keep your arms straight.
Your arms should go from small circles to big circles.
Breathe regularly.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.
This exercise targets your deltoids.
This exercise really helps loosen up your shoulders.
This is a great exercise to build arm muscle endurance.

introduce: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart. Place your hands on both sides of your waist, fingers facing downwards and elbows facing outwards.\n\nGently pull your elbows backward, then bring them back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: ELBOWS BACK

tips.text: It is a good stretching exercise for your shoulders and chest.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your forearm supporting your body and knees bent on the floor. \n\nKeep your spine straight. Hold this position.
name: KNEELING SIDE PLANK LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Please tighten your core.
Breathe naturally.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
If you feel it's too easy, you can straighten your legs.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your forearm supporting your body and knees bent on the floor. \n\nKeep your spine straight. Hold this position.
name: KNEELING SIDE PLANK RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Please tighten your core.
Breathe naturally.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
If you feel it's too easy, you can straighten your legs.
